reuse.why: setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg and the new setLastMonthSpending share a new getEditableCategories helper and reuse setBudget/getSheetValue/batchMessages, but copyPreviousMonth does not use that helper and re-applies the rules per row.

duplication.why: The saved-template rule exists twice (SQL TRIM(goal_def) IN ('','[]','null') in getEditableCategoryFilter and JS hasSavedTemplates), the hidden rule twice (SQL filter and copyPreviousMonth's includeHiddenCategories branch), and the fixed-group exclusion twice (getEditableCategories filter and copyPreviousMonth check).

placement.why: All selection logic sits in budget/actions.ts next to the actions and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the month-wide actions, the new method and tests; only minor extra (BudgetData type widened).

maintainability.why: One selection helper serves most actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps a parallel per-row implementation of every exclusion, so a future exclusion must be added in two shapes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts skips getEditableCategories and applies hidden, template and #fixed checks inline over getBudgetData rows.

disguised_duplication.where: Template check reshaped as SQL (getEditableCategoryFilter) and as JS (hasSavedTemplates); hidden and #fixed rules re-expressed as row checks in copyPreviousMonth.

abstraction_drift.where: getEditableCategories/getEditableCategoryFilter gained includeHidden with a conditional hidden SQL fragment; copyPreviousMonth bypasses the helper and re-implements its rules.
